No Bitcoin broadcast at or after 15:00; attempts end by 15:25; records and all authorization end by 15:30 or earlier signed validUntil. Attempt 6 starts, retry requires published ATTEMPT_ABORT and explicit VERITAS_RETRY_REQUEST. Any missing prerequisite yields NO_START / PREREQUISITE_OPEN, with no in-window amendment. F12 remains OPEN.
